Checks for welfare walks in detail
Staff will learn why careful work counts
Companion Animal Travel Desk welfare checks

This section sets out routine care for animals moving through Aurelia Skyways. The purpose is to keep each check calm, consistent, and safe for the animal and for staff.

Staff must approach every animal with quiet movement, steady speech, and simple actions that reduce stress. Handlers should avoid sudden contact, loud signals, or crowded handling areas. If an animal shows fear, discomfort, or resistance, staff must pause and adjust the method so the animal can settle before work continues. A calm method is required at all stages of desk work, including intake, document review, handoff, and release.

Before any transfer, staff must confirm that the carrier, travel details, and welfare notes are in order. The companion animal travel desk should keep the animal separated from sources of noise, heat, and unnecessary handling. If a concern appears, staff must report it at once to the senior coordinator and record the issue in the desk log. No staff member should improvise a remedy that has not been approved through normal review.

When a hazard is identified, the safety coordinator reviews the risk and recommends prevention steps. Staff must follow that guidance without delay and must cooperate with any inspection or corrective action. If the first response does not resolve the concern, the issue moves through a calm stepwise review until it is settled or escalated to the proper manager. This process protects the animal and keeps decisions clear for the whole team.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk must preserve a respectful tone with travelers while keeping welfare first in every exchange. If further guidance is needed, contact the senior coordinator or the safety coordinator.
